errors.text_span: 随着横轴数值增大，柱子高度逐渐降低
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization. The bar height does not strictly decrease; for example, the bar at 2² (approx. 17) is taller than the bar at 2¹ (approx. 12), and the bar at 2⁴ (approx. 15) is taller than the bar at 2³ (10).
The description omits the rightmost bar in the chart, located after the x-axis tick for 2¹⁰.

errors.text_span: 可能用于拟合频数分布
errors.evidence: The description speculates about the purpose of the red curve ('may be used to fit the frequency distribution'), which is an interpretation forbidden by the prompt.

errors.text_span: 但根据上下文可推断红色曲线代表频数分布的拟合趋势，蓝色柱状图代表实际观测到的频数
errors.evidence: The description makes an inference about what the chart elements represent ('it can be inferred from the context...'), which is explicitly forbidden by the prompt that asks for objective description of visual content only.

errors.text_span: 符合典型的幂律分布形态
errors.evidence: This clause interprets the data by applying an external scientific concept ('conforms to the typical power-law distribution form'), which goes beyond objective description of the visual information.
